semiconductor_relevance: High — Found Four specializes in innovative equipment for thin-film deposition, crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Found Four is an innovative equipment manufacturer that focuses on advanced thin-film deposition technologies, specifically combining Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) and Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) in a single machine. Their SC-1 series equipment is designed for high-speed, high-quality film deposition, catering to various industries including semiconductor, medical, and optical fields.
capabilities: ALD and PVD hybrid deposition equipment
Multilayer film formation without target removal
Support for a wide variety of materials including Al2O3, ZnO, and TiO2

regional_presence.Switzerland: Found Four is headquartered in Spiez, Bern, Switzerland, where it develops its innovative equipment.
